title: Dragonsong

note: conf=0.96; Title and author confirmed. The proposed series string "Pern (Harper Hall Trilogy)" mixes the broad universe with a parenthetical; the tight, actually-published sub-series is the Harper Hall Trilogy, in which Dragonsong is book 1 (publisher listings: "Harper Hall Trilogy, Book 1"). The filename's "Pern 03" reflects an internal-chronology/publication numbering of the wider Dragonriders of Pern universe, not this book's position in the trilogy.
